readScope: XML phylogenetic methods/results, type material, diagnosis, variation, distribution/ecology/conservation, all five comparison paragraphs and all three Discussion paragraphs; independent sequences, supplement and original comparator vouchers not analysed
name: Leptobrachella kungfu
reason: No exact pinned accepted species match; no fabricated ID or completion count
sections: morphology
Six male types and no female measurements
六个雄性模式及缺少雌性测量

All six types were collected on 29 April 2025 at Mt. Laoxiangshan, Foshan; the holotype is GEP a419. Male SVL is 25.7–28.2 mm; females are not measured in this series. Diagnostic traits combine finger fringes absent, broad toe fringes, rudimentary toe webbing, continuous under-toe ridges, no dorsal skin ridges and a pale smooth underside. This small same-date male series is not a sex-complete population range.
六件模式均于2025年4月29日在佛山老香山采集，正模GEP a419；雄吻肛长25.7–28.2毫米，系列未测雌性。诊断组合为指缘缺失、宽趾缘、退化趾蹼、趾下连续棱、无背皮棱及浅光滑腹面。同日小雄性系列不是涵盖两性的种群范围。
distribution
Type and ecological elevations disagree
模式与生态海拔不同

The type material gives about 250 m at Laoxiangshan; the ecological account gives about 800–1400 m while saying the species is known only from the type locality. This internal disagreement is retained, not corrected into one continuous occupied band. Streams, granite forest and calling perches are author observations, not complete physiological habitat limits.
模式材料给老香山约250米，生态记述则在称仅知模式地点时给约800–1400米。保留内部差异，不修正为连续占据带。溪流、花岗岩林及鸣叫栖位属于作者观察，不是完整生理生境界限。
reproduction
Calling observations and a dated DD proposal
鸣叫观察及有年代的DD建议

Males called on rocks or dwarf-shrub leaves near flowing seeps. Authors report February–June breeding from long-term observations, without a fully sampled reproductive chronology in the read scope. They propose Data Deficient because distribution and threats are insufficiently understood. This is not a verified current official category, population trend or complete egg/larval account.
雄在流水渗出处附近岩石或矮灌叶上鸣叫。作者依长期观察报告二月至六月繁殖，已读范围未给完整取样繁殖时序；因分布、威胁了解不足而提议资料缺乏。这不是已核实当前官方等级、种群趋势或完整卵／幼体记述。
evolution
Short mitochondrial evidence supports the proposed lineage
短线粒体证据支持所提支系

The six new samples form a supported lineage in a 512-base-pair 16S matrix, sister to yunkaiensis at reported mean p-distance 4.9%, bootstrap support 99 and posterior probability 1.00. This complements morphological comparison but supplies no nuclear-genome isolation, direct gene-flow or divergence-date estimate. Broad reference sampling is not new field evidence for every included species.
六个新样本在512碱基对16S矩阵成有支持支系，与yunkaiensis为姐妹，所报平均p距离4.9%、BS99/BPP1.00。它补充形态比较，却不提供核基因组隔离、直接基因流或分化日期估计。广泛参考取样不是每个纳入物种的新野外证据。
